lines: We played outside in the dirt today,
now let's wash our hands the bubbly way!
Soap and water, rub, rub, rub,
scrub between your fingers, scrub, scrub, scrub!
Rinse them off and dry them too,
clean hands, happy hands for me and you!
One, two, three, little stars so bright,
twinkle, twinkle in the night!
Four, five, six, they shine so far,
wave hello to every star!
Seven, eight, nine, and ten stars too,
ten little stars say hi to you!
Pitter patter, rain is here,
grab your boots and raincoat, dear!
Jump in puddles, splash, splash, splash,
muddy boots go dash, dash, dash!
Now the sun comes out to play,
a big bright rainbow says hooray!
Toys are on the floor, oh my,
clean up, clean up, let's all try!
Pick up leaves and pick up sticks,
helping out is quick, quick, quick!
Everything is clean, hooray,
now it's time to run and play!
Big and small, big and small,
Bunny's big and Chick is small!
Up and down, up and down,
fly up high, then float back down!
Fast and slow, fast and slow,
run so fast, then tiptoe slow!
Dance, dance, wiggle all around,
then freeze like ice and don't make a sound!
Spin, spin, spin like falling leaves,
now freeze like a statue, if you please!
Jump, jump, jump up to the sky,
freeze and wave and say goodbye!
One little duck goes for a swim,
two little ducks swim after him!
Three little ducks walk past the barn,
four little ducks hop round the farm!
Five little ducks all in a row,
one, two, three, four, five, let's go!
